questions.question: After his son Jonathan defended David, what did King Saul do?

answers.text: Swore an oath to spare David

questions.question: While David played the harp for King Saul, what did Saul try to do with his spear?
When King Saul's messengers were watching David's house, how did David's wife Michal help him escape?

answers.text: She lowered him from a window
She sneaked him out the back gate
She hid him in a cart

questions.question: When King Saul's messengers went to seize David and met Samuel with the men around him, what happened to them?

answers.text: The Spirit of God came on them and they began to prophesy
They seized David on the spot
